name: Voxel Face Visibility Check
definition: Determines which of the six cube faces are visible by computing the dot product between each face's center and its outward normal, marking it visible if the dot product is positive.
summary: Voxel Face Visibility Check is a geometric optimization that determines which of a voxel block's six faces are visible to the camera, enabling finer-grained culling than methods that discard entire blocks.
